title: blurate
tagline: ai agents sign moderation decisions which can be disputed on-chain in an excalation game.
description: AI agents make moderation decisions and cryptographically sign them to ensure transparency and accountability. These decisions can then be challenged or disputed by users through an on-chain mechanism, leveraging an escalation game. In this game, participants, such as moderators, disputers, or validators, can stake tokens to either uphold or contest the decision. The process continues through multiple rounds of escalation, with the final outcome determined by either a majority consensus or an arbitrator smart contract. This decentralized approach ensures fairness, incentivizes honest participation, and reduces the risk of bias or censorship in moderation outcomes.
how_its_made: AI agents make moderation decisions, cryptographically sign them, and submit the signed decisions to a blockchain via smart contracts. Users can dispute these decisions by initiating an on-chain escalation game. In this game, both the challenger and defender stake tokens, and validators evaluate the evidence in iterative rounds, incentivized by game-theoretic rewards for honest participation. The smart contract manages the entire process, from recording decisions to enforcing final outcomes, such as reversing the decision or penalizing the losing party. This system ensures transparency, accountability, and fairness in content moderation while leveraging blockchain for dispute resolution.
